items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This became a co-led project; it morphed into that.

ctx.x: E-1, that’s right. Well, let’s go ahead and discuss Music We Are. On your website you have a clip of the group working on this… You’ve got John Patitucci talking, you’ve got Danilo Perez.

Yeah. Actually that’s a two-disc package. It has two discs in it. One is the music and one is the video that we had shot by Arav Osiri (?), and it documents our feelings about each other, and about the music, and how it all came together. I did Danilo’s first album as a leader while doing a recording with a Chinese guitarist named Eugene Pao, which had John Patitucci on it. I suggested to John that he and Danilo would really work well together, and that actually turns out to be the case, as they’re part of Wayne…
No, please talk about it now. We’re talking about your projects.
